title: Crab Derby, 2008 · before
logline: The day before the twenty-fourth: Gully at the Newport weekly's counter paying for an ad, twenty bucks, and asking if they'll run the flyer as drawn. The clerk says it's a flyer. Gully says it's an ad now. Wood outside with the dog, not going in.
